author: Jonathan
description_zh:
守住你的基地！敌军将一波接一波地进攻 —— 击杀敌军赚取金钱。

【详细玩法】
可以买步兵坦克等部队。
操作：左键 点选/拖框选，WASD平移视角，滚轮 缩放，右键机动(直奔目标)/点敌人=集火，Q/E旋转视角，空格 停止所选部队，Esc 暂停。
游戏目标：击退敌方军队，游戏结束的唯一条件是己方失败。
description_en:
Defend your base! Enemy forces will attack wave after wave -- kill enemies to earn money.

[Detailed Gameplay]
You can buy infantry, tanks, and other units.
Controls: Left click to select/drag select, WASD to pan camera, Scroll wheel to zoom, Right click to move (direct to target) / click enemy to focus fire, Q/E to rotate camera, Space to stop selected units, Esc to pause.
Goal: Repel the enemy army. The only condition for game over is your defeat.
